title: Final 06 K20 Potwierdza Belicosa
description: Krótki, znany już znak: kostka świeci, więc efekt za chwilę nastąpi.

prompts.image: Photorealistic 16:9 extreme static macro immediately after the throw in final-05. Preserve the same open manual page, sepia Belicosa schematic, paper fibers and warm room light. The canonical K20 is fully at rest on the page: a real 3 cm regular icosahedral tabletop die with translucent deep-emerald faces and aged-gold framework. Shallow macro depth of field, small believable contact shadow. Activation is only beginning as concentrated green-gold light inside the lower faces casts one narrow reflection across the paper and cannon drawing. Exactly five numerals are clearly readable, each once: 8 on the upper face, 4 upper-right, 19 central, 2 center-left and 6 lower-right. All other face numbers are hidden by angle, framework, reflection or focus; no zero, duplicate or visible result. The Belicosa remains only a recognizable fragment of the single-barrel technical drawing beneath the die. No hands, people, second die, giant scale, physical cannon, auspex, rooftop, ships, explosion, floating die, outward beam, subtitles, UI or watermark.

One continuous 2-second macro. The internal light rises once
